2610.06650.title: Wikidata Search Traces: A Dataset for Training Knowledge Graph Search Agents
2610.06650.paper_summary: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.
2610.06650.paper_summary_zh: Wikidata 是最大的開放知識庫之一，但對其進行複雜問題的回答仍然需要一個 SPARQL 查詢，該查詢需要正確命名實體和屬性並鏈接它們的關係。語言模型提供了一種自然語言的替代方案，但主要是從記憶中回答，這對於不太突出的實體來說可靠性最低。我們研究的代理則是通過探索圖形來回答問題，並認為有兩個障礙限制了它們：缺乏記錄解決者如何探索的訓練數據，以及將大型圖形結果直接添加到模型上下文中的介面。我們測試三個假設：圖形搜索的難度可以通過問題的結構來控制，而不僅僅是通過不明顯的實體或措辭；長期搜索失敗的很大一部分來自於如何管理檢索到的證據，而不是模型本身；在合適的環境中，開放權重模型可以與商業封閉模型相匹配。我們通過用嵌套條件替換命名實體，在凍結的 Wikidata 快照上構建多跳問題，在每次擴展後檢查目標是否仍然唯一以及每個新條件是否必要。我們釋放了 10,235 條針對單一實體和多跳問題的解決追蹤，連同生成它們的遞歸語言模型 (RLM) 體系，在該體系中，模型批量處理圖形調用，將結果保留在持久的 Python 狀態中，並通過子調用解釋選定的證據。在 100 個問題上，該體系改善了我們在兩個介面下運行的兩個模型，與直接調用同一功能的工具相比：gpt-6-luna 的正確答案從 49 上升到 61，將其多跳準確率翻倍，而 Qwen3.8-27B，一個在單個 GPU 上提供的開放權重模型，則從 60 上升到 74。
